svg.aria-label: Home base: a Linux Mint desktop themed to look like macOS Tahoe, with a transparent kitty terminal running fastfetch
svg.title: Home base: a Linux Mint desktop themed to look like macOS Tahoe, with a transparent kitty terminal running fastfetch
svg.desc: Cinnamon on Linux Mint 22.3, rebuilt by hand to look like macOS Tahoe: a dark GTK theme, SF Pro, the Bibata cursor, a Plank dock and a terminal tuned until it feels native.
